name: VOA Learning English
description_short: Free English-learning news, video and audio content with learner-friendly language, transcripts and vocabulary support.
creator: Voice of America
internal_notes: No login required to browse or watch — confirmed live. cefr_level left unknown rather than guessed: the site organises content into its own Beginning/Intermediate/Advanced navigation, not CEFR bands, so mapping to A1-C1 would be an inference not stated by the source. age_group left unknown: content is deliberately simplified-language news/media aimed at adult English learners generally, with no stated child/teen suitability claim the way LearnEnglish Teens makes explicitly, and some news topics may need teacher pre-screening for a younger class. group_fit and teaching_use left unassessed/empty for the same broad-archive reason as iSLCollective/LearnEnglish Teens: this is browsable media a teacher selects from, not one activity with a single assessable format.
